description: This file defines functions for configuring and managing a MBIM-based network interface in a Unix-like system. It includes initialization, setup, teardown, and communication with the UMIM utility, along with JSON-based configuration handling.

methods.name: proto_mbim_init_config
methods.description: Initializes default configuration options for the MBIM protocol.

methods.name: _proto_mbim_get_field
methods.description: Extracts specific field values from the MBIM configuration.

methods.name: proto_mbim_setup
methods.description: Sets up the MBIM protocol interface, handling retries upon failure.

methods.name: proto_mbim_teardown
methods.description: Tears down the MBIM protocol interface, disconnecting and cleaning up state.
